tool.name: RFEM MC Batch Runner
tool.description: Generate a collection of spatially correlated random field instances
tool.help:
Runs the RFEM Thermal Field Generator in a loop to produce a collection of independent random field realizations.
Each realization generates instance-specific mesh (.d), control (.dat), and material (.mat) files, which are bundled into a tar.gz archive.
This tool produces a **Dataset Collection** which is intended to be used with the "map-over" feature in Galaxy to run the RFEM Thermal Solver on all instances in parallel.
